VirtualDAP links dynamically to libusb 1.0.30 (LGPL-2.1-or-later).
Full license: APK asset notices/libusb-LICENSE.txt.
Upstream source: https://github.com/libusb/libusb
Pinned source: 87a55632db62c9bdc58cd31d3ccfa673f1bb017f

libusb source is included as third_party/libusb in the VirtualDAP source tree.
Its Android configuration is used without modification. The CMake build definition
is in app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt. The complete VirtualDAP source can be rebuilt
and signed with a developer's own key, including a modified libusb shared library.
UAPP code and proprietary audio libraries are not included.
